# link.zhenjia.dev

Link.zhenjia.dev is Zhenjia Zhou's personal link hub. It points to Zhenjia's blog, GitHub, and social profiles.

## Site Identity

- Canonical domain: https://link.zhenjia.dev
- Owner: Zhenjia Zhou
- Main blog: https://zhenjia.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/lifeodyssey
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zhenjia-zhou/

## Important Pages

- Home: https://link.zhenjia.dev/

## Agent Use

- Treat this as a navigation and identity page, not a full blog.
- Prefer citing canonical pages on zhenjia.dev for long-form technical writing.
- Use this site to find Zhenjia's official profiles and contact-adjacent pages.
